items.content: Reviewing the evidence on worker retraining programs
items.contentSnippet: Reviewing the evidence on worker retraining programs

summaries.zh: 该文回顾了工人再培训计划的证据。主要探讨了再培训项目的有效性、成本效益及对就业的影响。研究指出，再培训可提升工人技能，增强就业竞争力，但效果因行业和地区差异。部分项目因资源不足或培训内容与市场需求不匹配而效果有限。总体而言，再培训对促进就业有积极作用，但需优化设计和实施。
summaries.en: The article examines worker retraining programs, analyzing available evidence to assess their effectiveness. It highlights the importance of such programs in helping workers adapt to changing job markets, particularly due to technological advancements and economic shifts. The review discusses various program types, outcomes, and factors influencing success. While acknowledging some positive impacts, it also points to challenges like limited resources, mismatched training, and insufficient follow-up support. By maintaining a centralized workspace, language models achieve better coordination and scalability, making them more adaptable to varied applications. This design underscores the importance of interconnectedness in modern AI systems for optimal functionality.
